claims.content: To request update information on a specific TN by initiating a J7.1 (ACT = 1 or 2) Data Update Request message addressed to a specific Addressee TN(s) or to the collective address of 00177 octal, so that responding JU(s) reply with surveillance information.

goal.raw_text: To request update information on a specific TN by initiating a J7.1 (ACT = 1 or 2) Data Update Request message addressed to a specific Addressee TN(s) or to the collective address of 00177 octal, so that responding JU(s) reply with surveillance information.

claims.content: C2 JU
A specific TN is available for the update request and is to be placed in the Reference TN field of the J7.1 message.
The update request is either a Data Update Request by TN (ACT = 1) or a Ballistic Missile Update Request (ACT = 2).
An addressee for the J7.1 (ACT = 1 or 2) message is identified as a specific Addressee TN(s) or the collective address of 00177 octal.

The requesting JU initiates a J7.1 (ACT = 1 or 2) message with a specific TN in the Reference TN field and addressed to a specific Addressee TN(s) or to the collective address of 00177 octal to request update information on that TN.

trigger.raw_text: The requesting JU initiates a J7.1 (ACT = 1 or 2) message with a specific TN in the Reference TN field and addressed to a specific Addressee TN(s) or to the collective address of 00177 octal to request update information on that TN.

claims.content: The requesting JU initiates a J7.1 (ACT = 1 or 2) message with the specific TN in the Reference TN field and addressed to a specific Addressee TN(s) or to the collective address of 00177 octal.
The responding JU(s), whether a specific address or collective addressee, reply as described.
Upon receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message on a specific TN, the JU with R² shall respond with surveillance information and shall transmit all data.

Upon receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message on a specific TN, the JU(s) that have originated surveillance amplification data on the track shall respond with the J6.0 Amplification message containing all available data.

C2 JUs receiving a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message containing their own TN shall transmit J10.2 Engagement Status messages to report the status of all engagements they are conducting and a J13 Platform and System Status message to report their own status.

The C2 JU with R² for the Reference TN shall respond with a J3.6 Space Track message upon receipt of a J7.1 message with the Data Update Request Action field set to value 2, Ballistic Missile Update Request, on a specific TN.
The C2 JU shall transmit the data held in the appropriate J3.6 word sequence.
At main flow step 5, if the JU is NonR², it shall not respond to a J7.1 (ACT = 2) Ballistic Missile Update Request.

At main flow step 5, if an R² shift occurs during execution of a DUR response, where the Number/Frequency of Updates field is set to value 2 or 3, the JU assuming R² shall not respond to any prior Data Update Request.

Exception 1: At main flow step 5, if the JU is NonR² and receives a J7.1 (ACT = 2) Ballistic Missile Update Request, the JU shall not respond. Exit: no Ballistic Missile Update response is sent by the NonR² JU.

Exception 2: If an R² shift occurs during execution of a DUR response, where the Number/Frequency of Updates field is set to value 2 or 3, the JU assuming R² shall not respond to any prior Data Update Request. Exit: the JU assuming R² does not respond to any prior Data Update Request.
The requesting JU has initiated a J7.1 (ACT = 1 or 2) message with the specific TN in the Reference TN field and addressed to a specific Addressee TN(s) or to the collective address of 00177 octal.
The responding JU(s), whether a specific address or collective addressee, have replied as described.
When the request is a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message on a specific TN, the JU with R² has responded with surveillance information and has transmitted all data.

When the request is a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message on a specific TN, the JU(s) that have originated surveillance amplification data on the track have responded with the J6.0 Amplification message containing all available data.

C2 JUs receiving a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message containing their own TN have transmitted J10.2 Engagement Status messages to report the status of all engagements they are conducting and a J13 Platform and System Status message to report their own status.

When the request is a J7.1 message with the Data Update Request Action field set to value 2, Ballistic Missile Update Request, on a specific TN, the C2 JU with R² for the Reference TN has responded with a J3.6 Space Track message.
The JU has transmitted the data held in the appropriate J3.6 word sequence.
